jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text: Assist Shipping/Receiving/Logistics and Manufacturing managers with activities of fast paced manufacturing operation. Assist with multiple projects related to inventory control, product configuration, scanning systems training, point of use improvements, shipments and general receiving, central warehousing, materials crib and general stores activities. Assist with continuous improvement opportunities.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Minimum Qualifications: 

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field (Junior or Senior level)
  • A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0
  • Must have local housing within 50 miles of our work location. 
  • Strong interpersonal skills with an outgoing and collaborative approach.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and solve problems.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook); SAP knowledge is a plus.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only.  Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable. 

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.

Please note that employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.
